arm_mvfr1.title: ARM Architecture Reference Manual ARMv8, for ARMv8-A architecture profile
arm_mvfr1.definition: Only value1 advertises single-precision Advanced SIMD; requires SIMDInt1

arm_instruction_semantics.interpretation: VMOV modified immediates assign bit patterns through AdvSIMDExpandImm; FHM uses esize32, FPMulAddH with half inputs and FP32 accumulators. Pure FP16 has its own SIMDHP admission.

qemu.profiles: max: MVFR0=10110222 MVFR1=13211111; cortex-a15,neon=off,vfp-d32=off: MVFR0=10110221 MVFR1=11000011
qemu.scope: Full execution/undefined controls for 91 operations in ARM/Thumb on two different valid CPU profiles; not per-field isolation or physical A32 proof.

rejected_oracle_attempts.reason: Old .arch/.fpu directives overrode requested ISA features; max exposes no vfp-d32 property.
Assembler directives corrected; max,neon=off is rejected because D32 and Neon must be paired. Raw outputs retained.
